environment.target: evals/fixtures/flow-app/after/today.html opened from a file URL

steps.evidence: activated #start-workout by pointer; afterwards workout.html shows “Active workout” with 0 logged set(s).
activated #add-set by pointer; afterwards workout.html shows the dialog “Add set”.

chose “Bench press” in #exercise by pointer, typed “60” in #weight by pointer, typed “8” in #reps by pointer, activated #save-set by pointer; afterwards workout.html shows “Active workout” with 1 logged set(s).
activated #workout-view > .row #finish by pointer; afterwards workout.html shows “Couldn't save your workout. Your sets are still on this device.” with the controls: Try again, Discard workout.
switched the fixture's connection control to online; afterwards workout.html shows “Couldn't save your workout. Your sets are still on this device.” with the controls: Try again, Discard workout.
activated #retry by pointer; afterwards summary.html shows the heading “Workout saved” and 1 logged set(s): Bench press: 60 kg × 8.

success_evidence: The run ended where summary.html shows the heading “Workout saved” and 1 logged set(s): Bench press: 60 kg × 8.
limitations: A static fixture opened from a file URL; no server, account, or real network is involved.
The lost connection is simulated with the fixture's connection control.
